create.name: Ūñcagāṁv
create.about: The village of Lalitā-sakhī; Lalitā-sthala and the temple of Dāūjī (Baladeva) are here, and the Phisalanī-śilā, the sliding stone.

create.name: Vṛṣabhānu-kuṇḍa
create.about: The kuṇḍa of Mahārāja Vṛṣabhānu, Śrī Rādhā's father, at Vṛṣabhānupura (Varṣāṇā).

create.name: Sāṅkarī-khor
create.location: The narrow pass between the two hills of Varṣāṇā (coordinates approximate)
create.about: In this narrow pass Kṛṣṇa and His friends stopped the gopīs carrying yoghurt and butter, demanding a tax (dāna-līlā).

create.name: Dāna-garh
create.location: On the hills of Varṣāṇā (coordinates approximate)
create.about: A place of the dāna-līlā on the Varṣāṇā hills.

create.name: Māna-garh
create.location: On the hills of Varṣāṇā (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Where Śrī Rādhā showed Her sulky mood (māna) and Kṛṣṇa pacified Her; Lalitā-kuṇḍa is nearby.

create.name: Mayūra-kuṭī
create.location: On the hills of Varṣāṇā (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Where Kṛṣṇa danced like a peacock (mayūra) to please Śrī Rādhā.

create.name: Gahvaravana (Varṣāṇā)
create.location: Behind the hills of Varṣāṇā (coordinates approximate)
create.about: A dense forest of Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, with Gahvara-kuṇḍa.

create.name: Pīlī-pokharā
create.about: The «yellow pond»: Rādhikā washed Her hands here after Yaśodā had smeared them with turmeric, and its water became yellow.

create.name: Prema-sarovara
create.about: The «lake of love», formed of the tears of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in their prema; the deities of Śrī Prema-bihārījī are on its bank.

create.name: Saṅket
create.location: Midway between Varṣāṇā and Nandagāṁv (coordinates approximate)
create.about: The secret meeting place (saṅketa) of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa; the temple of Saṅket-bihārī, Saṅket-devī (Vīrā-devī), a rāsa-maṇḍala and the place of the swing are here.
create.source: Śrī Vraja-maṇḍala Parikramā (after the Varṣāṇā parikramā)

create.name: Pāvana-sarovara
create.location: At the foot of Nandīśvara hill, Nandagāṁv (coordinates approximate)
create.about: Kṛṣṇa's cows drank and bathed here; Vṛṣabhānu built a palace for Rādhikā on its northern bank. On the south-eastern bank is the bhajana-kuṭī of Sanātana Gosvāmī, who sometimes went from here to meet Rūpa Gosvāmī at Ṭer-kadamba.

create.name: Āśeśvara Mahādeva
create.about: Śiva came here hoping (āśā) to see baby Kṛṣṇa; Yaśodā at first refused because of his dress, and later let him.

create.name: Uddhava-kyārī
create.about: Where Uddhava, sent by Kṛṣṇa from Mathurā, met the gopīs in their separation and heard Rādhā's Bhramara-gīta.
